description: An improved version of my old MWYHL deck.
strategy:
I decided to take out the Insurrection and all of the DB's in favor of some better cards. The Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) is now much more useful and prominent in the deck.

Locations are unchanged minus the lack of DB's

Characters have been really revamped I decided not to train DOS as training SOS is faster (less deploy cost, +1 to training). I decided to add Leia with gun and Leia ,RP (added her matching gun, because hit characters are LOST!!). Master Luke is in to do a persona replacement on SOS after I finish training, his ability is great with a seven on test 5. Last but not least we have lovely Jar-Jar, a blessed soul his is. His is in for reasons everyone should already know.

Starships are sparse, I added an HCF and have one more coming in the mail along with another Life Debt. I may add those and take out the stone piles haven't decided yet.

Weapons/Devices are largely unchanged. I added Electrobinoculars (pullable with Rycar) to help with training destinies and to help get that crucial seven on test 5.

Only the Reflection was added to the group of Effects, bascially to supplement my other retrival cards.

Interrupts underwent a large SAC change. I decided to use the Coruscant Sense and Alter because of their versititly.

Lemme know what you guys think.

Also if anyone has extra of the following cards please let me know...

x2 Obi-Wan with Lightsaber

x2 Qui-Gon with Lightsaber

Thanks Again
